purpose: Render the shopping cart page as server-side HTML including the totals table (Subtotal, Shipping, Tax, Total) of the visitor's own cart.

success.bodySignal: HTML with <div id="order-totals"> rows cart-summary-subtotal / cart-summary-shipping / cart-summary-tax / cart-summary-total; per line input name=itemquantity<cartItemId>; 'Your Shopping Cart is empty!' alert when no lines; an empty-cart page has no totals table and no Estimate shipping panel

purpose: Request a shipping estimate for a country, state and zip; the whole cart form is posted to /cart with the estimateshipping button and the answer is the re-rendered cart page (HTTP 200, no redirect).

bodyFields.name: estimateshipping
bodyFields.description: Submit button name; selects the estimate action (without it the same POST /cart does other cart actions).

bodyFields.name: CountryId
bodyFields.description: Country id from the CountryId select (3 Germany, 4 Austria, 5 Switzerland, 1 United States, 2 Canada, 86+ others). Non-numeric gives a validation message; 0 / unknown / missing still return the same shipping options.

bodyFields.name: StateProvinceId
bodyFields.description: State id from /country/getstatesbycountryid; 0 means 'Other (Non US)'. Empty string was sent by the browser for US before the states list loaded.

bodyFields.name: ZipPostalCode
bodyFields.description: Free text zip; never validated (abc, empty and 10001 all accepted).

bodyFields.name: itemquantity{{cartItemId}}
bodyFields.description: One field per cart line carrying its current quantity (id from the cart page); the browser always sends them, the server did not require them.

bodyFields.name: discountcouponcode
bodyFields.description: Discount code box content; sent empty by the browser.

bodyFields.name: giftcardcouponcode
bodyFields.description: Gift card code box content; sent empty by the browser.

success.bodySignal: HTML cart page; panel #cart-action-shipping-body shows an alert-success block listing options 'In-Store Pickup ($0.00)' and 'By Ground ($0.00)' and the posted country/state/zip selected; totals unchanged (Shipping $0.00, Tax $0.00). The estimate is not stored: a following GET /cart shows the panel empty again ('Enter your destination to get a shipping estimate').

failure.bodySignal: CountryId=abc: field-validation-error 'The value 'abc' is not valid for 'Country'.' (still 200 with the options). Empty cart: 200 with 'Your Shopping Cart is empty!' and no panel. Gift-card-only cart: 200, no estimate panel at all, Shipping row reads 'Not required'.

purpose: Load the state/province list for the selected country when the Country select changes in the Estimate shipping panel.

query.name: countryId
query.description: Country id (1 = United States: 62 entries; 3 = Germany: single entry id 0 'Other (Non US)').

query.name: addEmptyStateIfRequired
query.description: Add the 'Other (Non US)' entry for countries without states.

success.bodySignal: JSON array of {id, name} with a $type field, e.g. [{"id":0,"name":"Other (Non US)"}]

failure.bodySignal: countryId=abc, countryId=99999 or missing countryId: HTML '502 Bad Gateway' (proxy page, not JSON), reproduced twice

purpose: Change the quantity of one cart line and return the refreshed subtotal, line HTML and totals HTML (used here to see how totals follow quantity).

query.name: sciItemId
query.description: Cart line id (same number as in the itemquantity<id> field).

query.name: isCartPage
query.description: Cart page flag sent by the UI.

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, SubTotal:'$958.00 excl tax', message:[], cartHtml, totalsHtml (Subtotal/Shipping/Tax/Total rows), displayCheckoutButtons:true, newItemPrice:'$479.00 excl tax' (unit price for the new quantity)}

failure.bodySignal: qty 10001: 200 with success:false and message ['The maximum quantity allowed for purchase is 10000.'], SubTotal unchanged. qty 0 and -1: line is DELETED but the response is HTTP 500 JSON {error:true, controller:'shoppingcart', action:'updatecartitem', message:'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'}. qty abc and 2.5: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway HTML. (Quantity semantics belong to unit cart-quantity; recorded because they change totals.)

purpose: Seed the own session cart with a product (regular or gift card) so totals can be observed; full behaviour belongs to unit cart-add.
contentType: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8 (body-less POST needs empty data and X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest)

bodyFields.name: addtocart_{{productId}}.AddToCart.EnteredQuantity
bodyFields.description: Quantity for gift cards (the form value won the /1 in the path: 2 cards gave a $50 subtotal).

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true}. Product ids used: 4 Certina DS Podium Big Size $479, 21 $25 Virtual Gift Card, 6 Titleist Pro V1x $2.10, 8 Supreme Golfball $1.90, 14 High School Game Basketball $29.95.

purpose: Remove one cart line (used here to clean up) and return the new item count and totals HTML.

success.bodySignal:
JSON {cartItemCount:N, success:true, message:'The product has been removed.', cartHtml, totalsHtml, displayCheckoutButtons}; last line gives cartItemCount 0 and cartHtml '


'

purpose: Switch the display currency of the visitor (1 USD, 2 GBP, 3 AUD, 4 CAD); every price and total of the cart is re-rendered converted.

query.name: returnUrl
query.description: Where to redirect after the switch; an external URL or missing value redirects to '/'.

setCookies: SMARTSTORE.VISITOR (refreshed); the currency is kept server side per visitor, no currency cookie
success.bodySignal: no body; next GET /cart shows converted amounts: GBP x0.61 with HTML entity £ in curl output, AUD x0.94, CAD x0.98 (AUD and CAD both print '$')

failure.bodySignal: unknown numeric id 99: 302 to /cart, currency unchanged; non-numeric id abc: 404; returnUrl=https://example.org/: 302 to '/' (no open redirect)

purpose: Return the counters shown in the header (cart, wishlist, compare item counts); the page calls it after every cart action.

success.bodySignal: JSON {CartItemsCount, WishlistItemsCount, CompareItemsCount} with a $type field
